installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#
 ##

# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
apt -y update
apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
# the app id is fixed for this egg; a server created without the egg's defaults has it empty,
# and steamcmd then installs nothing without saying so
SRCDS_APPID=${SRCDS_APPID:-896660}

# a freshly downloaded steamcmd updates itself on its first run and then sometimes fails the
# app_update with "Missing configuration" - so it gets up to three tries
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit ## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6
    [[ -f /mnt/server/valheim_server.x86_64 ]] && break
    echo -e "\nsteamcmd did not install the game (attempt ${attempt} of 3)\n"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## fail the install instead of leaving a server without a game
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/valheim_server.x86_64 ]]; then
    echo -e "\nInstall failed: valheim_server.x86_64 is missing after three tries of steamcmd.\n"
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "\nValheim server installed.\n"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name that appears in server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Server password.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name to load if switching between multiple saved worlds.

variables.name: Public
variables.description:
Set the visibility of your server. 1 is default and
will make the server visible in the browser.
Set it to 0 to make the server invisible and only
joinable via the ‘Join IP’-button.
Setting public to 0 is a good option if you wish to
run a local LAN server, where players can join via
the local IP of the server.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Valheim steam app id for auto updates.

variables.name: LD Library Path
variables.description: Required to load server libraries.

variables.name: Console Filter
variables.description: Remove spam from the console output.

variables.name: Shutdown Command
variables.description: Commands to trigger a server shutdown.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Enable automatic updates.

variables.name: Enable Crossplay
variables.description: Enable crossplay support (PlayFab relay). Lets players from any platform join and removes the need for port forwarding.

variables.name: Server Name Color
variables.description: Change the Servernamecolor

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds. Default 1800 (30 minutes).

variables.name: Backups
variables.description: How many automatic backups are kept. The first uses the short interval, the rest the long interval.

variables.name: Backup Interval Short
variables.description: Interval between the first automatic backups, in seconds. Default 7200 (2 hours).

variables.name: Backup Interval Long
variables.description: Interval between the subsequent automatic backups, in seconds. Default 43200 (12 hours).

variables.name: Instance ID
variables.description: Only needed when hosting multiple crossplay servers on the same port and MAC address. Something unique per server so each gets its own PlayFab ID. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: World Modifier Preset
variables.description: Sets a world modifier preset. A preset overwrites all previously set modifiers, the individual modifiers below are applied after it. Leave empty to keep the world's own settings.

variables.name: Modifier: Combat
variables.description: Enemy difficulty. Empty = normal.

variables.name: Modifier: Death Penalty
variables.description: Skill loss and item drop on death. Empty = normal.

variables.name: Modifier: Resources
variables.description: Resource drop rate. Empty = normal.

variables.name: Modifier: Raids
variables.description: Frequency of base raid events. Empty = normal.

variables.name: Modifier: Portals
variables.description: Portal restrictions. casual = all items can be taken through portals, hard = ores and metals restricted plus more, veryhard = no portals at all. Empty = normal.

variables.name: World Modifier Keys
variables.description: Space separated list of world modifier keys to enable. Valid keys: nobuildcost, playerevents, passivemobs, nomap. Example: nobuildcost nomap
